description: Puerto Rico's rules on the water, as 787daily's rules page (/water/rules/) and hubs summarize them: Ley 430-2000 (licenses, ages, life jackets, alcohol, speed, jet skis, swimmers, buoys), kayaks, paddleboards and kites, registration and numbering, CBP reporting on arrival, protected areas (manatee zones, reserves, Mona), DRNA moorings, the coral law's fines and spearfishing. Give a topic in plain words ('alcohol', 'jet ski rental age', 'customs arriving from St Thomas', 'spearfishing with scuba'); returns the best-matching rules with their text, their citation with each article linked to the law's own text, the page row, sources and the day checked. No topic: the index of every rule. A summary, not legal advice: cite the citation links and the url.
